clauses.title: Components Safety
clauses.content: Components installed in information technology equipment must comply with the relevant safety requirements to protect operators against electric shock.

clauses.title: Protection Against Electric Shock
clauses.content: Accessible parts shall not be live under normal and single-fault conditions; insulation clearances and creepage distances must be strictly maintained.
